description: One Robinhood Chain token at the three moments, read from the chain now. The code pass (clean code, not clean, unread): verified source, launcher template, owner privileges, transfer-tax code, honeypot flags. The activity pass (passes, fails, not judged): the code again plus sells clearing, the pool not drained, the deployer share, the holder concentration tier. The size (sized $X, not sized): a share of the pool by tier when the entry test clears, with the one reason when not. verdict.moments carries the three with their reasons; verdict.key keeps the 0.3 word (ELIGIBLE, NOT_ELIGIBLE, FAIL, UNVERIFIED), mapped in verdict.keys. Computed under a named, dated ruleset (the optional ruleset argument) and marked beta; the facts are measured and timestamped. Jev probabilities as context when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set. Research only, not financial advice.

address.description: Token contract address on Robinhood Chain (0x + 40 hex characters).

ruleset.description: Which ruleset the verdict is computed under. A preset name (keelage-default; "default" is short for keelage-default), or { lines: [{ key, value }] } to replace lines of keelage-default. Keys are the ones in keelage_record's rules: top10.conviction, top10.scout, pool.deep, size.poolShare, deployer.max, holders.min, entry.midPump, entry.minVolume24h, entry.minTurnoverOfMcap, entry.deepPoolTurnover, entry.convictionBelowPeak, liquidity.maxDrawdown, base.atBase, base.justOff, base.wellOff, jev.halveBands, sweep.minAgeDays, sweep.minPoolUsd, sweep.minMcapUsd, sweep.maxMcapUsd, size.poolShare.scout, activity.triggerVolume24h, watch.minMcapUsd, watch.sixHourlyMcapUsd, watch.hourlyMcapUsd. The facts never change; only the policy over them does. Omitted: keelage-default.

value.description: A number, or for a band line an array of numbers of the same length as the default.

wallet.description: Hosted server only: your wallet address (0x + 40 hex), the one that paid. The same as the X-Wallet header; the argument wins when both are sent. Priced calls past the free 20 a day draw on its credit, and every priced answer carries a credit line (credit: this call's price and where it was paid from, the free calls left today, the balance).

name: keelage_scan
